name: cc-data-anonymizer
description: Maskuje citlivá data (jména Notes, e-maily, hesla, tokeny) v promptech, @ souborech a výsledcích nástrojů přes CLI anon

style.title: Replacement style
style.description: How anon mask replaces values: fake (realistic fake values), redact (REDACTED, cannot be restored), tag («REDACTED:kind:n», restorable). "default" leaves it to anon (rules.toml).

consent.title: Consent dialog
consent.description: ask: the first read of a file with sensitive values asks for permission. never: mask with the configured style and only show the note, never ask. Agent sessions (CC_ROLE set) and non-interactive runs never ask.

reveal.title: Values on screen
reveal.description: How much of a detected value the findings list and the note under the row show (screen only, never the model): partial (names, e-mails, usernames, hosts and IPs in full; passwords, secrets and tokens as first 2 and last 2 characters), full, none.

unmaskReply.title: Unmask replies on screen
unmaskReply.description: Show the assistant's replies with the original values (the model still sees fakes).
